concepts.name: immersive experience
concepts.definition: An immersive experience is a perceived experience through sensory organs that appears real, because a person cannot distinguish the experienced environment from their real environment and perceives it as that real environment.

defining_facts.text: An immersive experience is a perceived experience through sensory organs that appears real: when a person experiences an environment through sensory organs and fails to distinguish that environment from the person's real environment, perceiving it as the real environment, the technology producing that experience is an immersive technology.

never_defined.name: mouse
never_defined.definition: Mouse is an input device used with computer or console displays, and used in virtual reality to control an avatar's locomotion.

never_defined.name: screen
never_defined.definition: A screen is a display on which an image or content is shown so that a human can perceive it.

never_defined.name: computer-generated stimuli
never_defined.definition: Computer-generated stimuli are stimuli that a virtual reality system provides to a user's sensory organs for an immersive experience of an artificial or synthetic environment.

never_defined.name: user action
never_defined.definition: User action is an interaction by a user with elements in an environment, partially determining what happens in the environment.

never_defined.name: real time
never_defined.definition: Real time is a condition in which interactions are reflected immediately and content loading has minimal latency.

never_defined.name: computer-aided design system
never_defined.definition: A Computer-aided design system is a system that supports a virtual environment and interaction but does not support an immersive experience, because the user interacts with screen content through a mouse while still seeing the real world around the computer screen.

never_defined.name: video conferencing system
never_defined.definition: A video conferencing system is an interactive system that presents a real-world environment in real time through a screen, with the user remaining in the real world and the screen only aiding interaction, so it is not a virtual environment or an immersive experience.

never_defined.name: three-dimensional movie experience
never_defined.definition: A three-dimensional movie experience is a partly immersive, non-interactive experience that provides a virtual environment, but the viewer only watches and cannot change the displayed content.
